why:
I'm going to write fibmod.py directly rather than spend time on a long setup. The plan is to reduce n modulo P = 2(M+1), which fits in 31 bits, and split values into three 11-bit limbs so the arithmetic stays within range. I'll use a Fibonacci pair identity, fib(a+b) written in terms of F(a), F(a-1), F(b), and F(b+1), to combine results.

I'm planning the combination step: I'll track each Fibonacci pair as F(k+1) and F(k), recover F(k-1) by subtraction, and merge limbs with the identity F(a+b) = F(a)F(b+1) + F(a-1)F(b). For the final value only F(n) is needed, so the last combination can skip building a full pair. I'm also considering building the lookup tables lazily, since precomputing about 3×2048 entries looks cheap either way.
